limits: PowerShell syntax is not parsed by an AST: dynamic invocation, string-built paths, conditional execution and true reachability are not proven.
The k1..56 order is sourced from CodeShow Sequence field assignments; parent calls are a conservative lexical subset, not full function-call coverage.
Conditional outputs and nested JSON shapes may depend on runtime data; values, content and performance are not certified.
CodeSequence Smoke presence does not imply it was run, and no source code is executed or modified.

contract.path_focus_condition: selected PairPathAnchorFindingCounterpartIndex is present; other focus routes may not expose k children
contract.k_key_path: data.path_focus.<child_key> (only if corresponding selected focus was built)

COMPAT-PUBLIC-JSON.basis: Source-level public JSON keys, 56 path_focus child keys, and each k handler last-return ordered-map/counts keys. Dynamic and array-element shapes not fully parsed.
COMPAT-PUBLIC-JSON.verification_needed: Native CodeSequence Smoke with representative focused/unfocused selections and JSON snapshot comparison.

COMPAT-SELECTORS.basis: 2..12 distinct record IDs, default preview Top 10, max Top 20 and route selectors must remain stable.
COMPAT-SELECTORS.verification_needed: Boundary selectors, missing IDs, duplicate IDs, focus hierarchy and truncation behavior under PowerShell.

PERF-EAGER-LOAD.basis: 123 literal modules are dot-sourced in ces.ps1 before per-Action dispatch; static import count, not latency.
PERF-EAGER-LOAD.verification_needed: PowerShell startup time and process memory on representative platform; avoid changing load semantics during EC-154.

PERF-PARENT-REPLAY.basis: 19 of 56 children contain a freshParent re-invocation; 19 compare serialized parent JSON. Parent replays can amplify deep focused requests.
PERF-PARENT-REPLAY.verification_needed: Profile focused k1..56 work and serialized JSON volume; never infer exponential runtime from syntax alone.

PERF-HIGH-EDGE-CNF.basis: k56 contains bounded high-edge E64..E66 assignment enumeration and polynomial/CNF counting; no elapsed time or memory budget proven.
PERF-HIGH-EDGE-CNF.verification_needed: E63, E64, E65, E66 native throughput/memory and correctness fixtures with genuine directed SCC links.
